# Calendrical v0.10.0 - Table of Contents

> Localized month- and week-based calendars and calendar functions
based upon CLDR data via Localize.

## Pages

- [Calendrical](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Changelog](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Guides
  - [User-defined Calendars](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/calendar_behaviour.md)
  - [Available Calendars](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/calendar_summary.md)
  - [Migrating from ex_cldr_calendars](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/migration.md)
  - [Parsing dates, times, datetimes, and intervals](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/parsing.md)

## Modules

- [Calendrical](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.md): Calendar functions for calendars compatible with
Elixir's `Calendar` behaviour.
- [Calendrical.Date](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Date.md): Date parsing and helpers built on Calendrical's calendar
implementations and Localize's CLDR data.
- [Calendrical.Date.Parser](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Date.Parser.md): Locale-aware parser for user-typed date strings, with full
multi-calendar support.
- [Calendrical.DateTime](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.DateTime.md): DateTime parsing helpers built on Localize CLDR data and the
existing `Calendrical.Date` / `Calendrical.Time` parsers.
- [Calendrical.DateTime.Parser](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.DateTime.Parser.md): Locale-aware parser for user-typed date-time strings.
- [Calendrical.Gettext](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Gettext.md): Gettext backend for the Calendrical library.
- [Calendrical.Parser](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Parser.md): Unified locale-aware parser that dispatches user input to the
appropriate domain parser (date, time, datetime, or date range).
- [Calendrical.Time](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Time.md): Time parsing helpers built on Localize's CLDR data.
- [Calendrical.Time.Parser](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Time.Parser.md): Locale-aware parser for user-typed time strings.
- [Calendrical.TimeZone](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.TimeZone.md): Resolve textual time-zone identifiers captured by the
parser into UTC offsets.

- Gregorian Month-based Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Buddhist](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Buddhist.md): Implementation of the Thai Buddhist (Buddhist Era) calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Gregorian](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Gregorian.md): Implements the proleptic Gregorian calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Indian](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Indian.md): Implementation of the Indian National (Saka) calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Japanese](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Japanese.md): Implements the Japanese calendar that is calendrically
the same as the proleptic Gregorian calendar but has a
different era structure.
  - [Calendrical.Roc](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Roc.md): Implementation of the Republic of China (Minguo) calendar.

- Gregorian Week-based Calendars
  - [Calendrical.ISOWeek](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.ISOWeek.md): Implements the ISO Week calendar.
  - [Calendrical.NRF](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.NRF.md): Implements the US National Retail Federation
(NRF) calendar.

- Julian Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Julian](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Julian.md): Implements the proleptic Julian calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Julian.Dec25](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Julian.Dec25.md): Proleptic Julian calendar whose year begins on 25 December (the
*Nativity style* / *Christmas style*, used in parts of medieval
Europe and the early Holy Roman Empire).
  - [Calendrical.Julian.Jan1](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Julian.Jan1.md): Proleptic Julian calendar whose year begins on 1 January
(the modern "Circumcision style", widely adopted after 1582).
  - [Calendrical.Julian.March1](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Julian.March1.md): Proleptic Julian calendar whose year begins on 1 March (the
*Mos Bonnensis*, used in parts of medieval Europe).
  - [Calendrical.Julian.March25](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Julian.March25.md): Proleptic Julian calendar whose year begins on 25 March (the
*Annunciation style* / *Lady Day*, used in England before 1752
and in Florence and Pisa during the Middle Ages).
  - [Calendrical.Julian.Sept1](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Julian.Sept1.md): Proleptic Julian calendar whose year begins on 1 September (the
*Byzantine* indictional year, used by the Byzantine Empire and in
the Eastern Orthodox liturgical year).

- Lunisolar Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Chinese](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Chinese.md): Implementation of the Chinese lunisolar calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Hebrew](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Hebrew.md): Implementation of the Hebrew (Jewish) calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Korean](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Korean.md): Implementation of the Korean lunisolar calendar.
  - [Calendrical.LunarJapanese](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.LunarJapanese.md): Implementation of the Japanese lunisolar calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Lunisolar](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Lunisolar.md): Shared base implementation for Calendrical's lunisolar calendars.

- Ethiopic Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Ethiopic](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Ethiopic.md): Implementation of the Ethiopic calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Ethiopic.AmeteAlem](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Ethiopic.AmeteAlem.md): Implementation of the Ethiopic calendar with the *Amete Alem* (Era
of the World, *Anno Mundi*) year numbering.

- Islamic Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.Civil](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.Civil.md): Implementation of the tabular Islamic (Hijri) civil calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.Observational](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.Observational.md): Implementation of the *observational* (sighting-based) Islamic
calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.Rgsa](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.Rgsa.md): Implementation of the *Saudi Arabian sighting-based* Islamic
calendar (CLDR `:islamic_rgsa`).
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.Tbla](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.Tbla.md): Implementation of the tabular Islamic (Hijri) calendar based on the
*astronomical* epoch.
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.UmmAlQura](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.UmmAlQura.md): Implementation of the Saudi Arabian Umm al-Qura calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.UmmAlQura.Astronomical](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.UmmAlQura.Astronomical.md): Implements the Umm al-Qura calendar for determining the first day of each
Hijri month using the astronomical rules documented by R. H. van Gent.
  - [Calendrical.Islamic.UmmAlQura.ReferenceData](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Islamic.UmmAlQura.ReferenceData.md): Official Umm al-Qura first-day dates sourced from the dataset maintained by
R.H. van Gent (Utrecht University) and cross-referenced against the KACST
published tables.

- Ecclesiastical Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Ecclesiastical](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Ecclesiastical.md): Computes the dates of Christian ecclesiastical events for a given
Gregorian year.

- Other Calendars
  - [Calendrical.Composite](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Composite.md): A composite calendar uses one base calendar before a specified
transition date and a different calendar after, optionally chaining
multiple transitions to model a sequence of historical calendar
reforms.
  - [Calendrical.Coptic](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Coptic.md): Implementation of the Coptic calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Persian](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Persian.md): The present Iranian calendar was legally adopted on 31
March 1925, under the early Pahlavi dynasty. The law
said that the first day of the year should be the
first day of spring in "the true solar year", "as it
has been" ever so. It also fixes the number of days
in each month, which previously varied by year with
the sidereal zodiac.

- Fiscal-year Calendars
  - [Calendrical.FiscalYear](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.FiscalYear.md): Pre-built fiscal-year calendars for ISO 3166 territories.

- Behaviours
  - [Calendrical.Behaviour](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Behaviour.md): Provides default implementations of the `Calendar` and `Calendrical`
callbacks for algorithmic calendars.
  - [Calendrical.Formatter](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Formatter.md): Calendar formatter behaviour.

- Formatting
  - [Calendrical.Format](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Format.md): Renders Calendrical calendars as years, months, weeks, and days using a
pluggable formatter.

- Intervals
  - [Calendrical.Interval](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Interval.md): Constructs and compares date intervals for any Calendrical calendar.

- K-day Calculations
  - [Calendrical.Kday](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Kday.md): Provide K-Day functions for Dates, DateTimes and NaiveDateTimes.

- Preference
  - [Calendrical.Preference](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Preference.md): Resolves the preferred Calendrical calendar module for a CLDR locale or an
ISO 3166 territory.

- Eras
  - [Calendrical.Era](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.md): Encapsulates the era information for
known CLDR calendars.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Buddhist](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Buddhist.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Buddhist` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Chinese](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Chinese.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Chinese` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Coptic](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Coptic.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Coptic` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Dangi](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Dangi.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Dangi` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Ethiopic](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Ethiopic.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Ethiopic` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Ethiopic_amete_alem](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Ethiopic_amete_alem.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Ethiopic_amete_alem` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Hebrew](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Hebrew.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Hebrew` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Indian](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Indian.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Indian` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Islamic](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Islamic.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Islamic` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Islamic_civil](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Islamic_civil.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Islamic_civil` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Islamic_rgsa](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Islamic_rgsa.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Islamic_rgsa` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Islamic_tbla](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Islamic_tbla.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Islamic_tbla` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Islamic_umalqura](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Islamic_umalqura.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Islamic_umalqura` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Japanese](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Japanese.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Japanese` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Persian](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Persian.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Persian` calendar.
  - [Calendrical.Era.Roc](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Era.Roc.md): Implements a `year_of_era/{1, 2}` function to return
the year of era and the era number for the
`Calendrical.Era.Roc` calendar.

- Exceptions
  - [Calendrical.DateParseError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.DateParseError.md): Returned (or raised) by `Calendrical.Date.parse/2` when an input
string cannot be interpreted as a date.
  - [Calendrical.DateRangeParseError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.DateRangeParseError.md): Returned (or raised) by `Calendrical.Date.parse_range/2` when an
input cannot be interpreted as a date range, or when both
endpoints parsed successfully but the resulting range is invalid.
  - [Calendrical.DateTimeParseError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.DateTimeParseError.md): Returned (or raised) by `Calendrical.DateTime.parse/2` when an input
string cannot be interpreted as a datetime.
  - [Calendrical.Formatter.InvalidDateError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Formatter.InvalidDateError.md): Exception raised when a value supplied to a calendar formatter
is not a recognised date.
  - [Calendrical.Formatter.InvalidOptionError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Formatter.InvalidOptionError.md): Exception raised when an unknown option, or an option with an
invalid value, is supplied to a calendar formatter.
  - [Calendrical.Formatter.UnknownFormatterError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.Formatter.UnknownFormatterError.md): Exception raised when a calendar formatter module cannot be
resolved.
  - [Calendrical.IncompatibleCalendarError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.IncompatibleCalendarError.md): Exception raised when an operation is attempted between two
dates or datetimes that use incompatible calendars.
  - [Calendrical.IncompatibleTimeZoneError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.IncompatibleTimeZoneError.md): Exception raised when two datetimes that should be in the same
time zone are not.
  - [Calendrical.InvalidCalendarModuleError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.InvalidCalendarModuleError.md): Exception raised when a module is referenced as a calendar but
does not implement the `Calendar` (and `Calendrical`) behaviour.
  - [Calendrical.InvalidDateOrderError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.InvalidDateOrderError.md): Exception raised when two dates or times are not ordered from
earlier to later as required by the function being called.
  - [Calendrical.InvalidFormatError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.InvalidFormatError.md): Exception raised when an unknown date format width is supplied
to a localization function.
  - [Calendrical.InvalidPartError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.InvalidPartError.md): Exception raised when an unknown date part is supplied to a
localization function.
  - [Calendrical.InvalidTypeError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.InvalidTypeError.md): Exception raised when an unknown date format type is supplied
to a localization function.
  - [Calendrical.IslamicYearOutOfRangeError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.IslamicYearOutOfRangeError.md): Exception raised when an operation on the Umm al-Qura Islamic calendar
references a Hijri year that lies outside the embedded reference data.
  - [Calendrical.MissingFieldsError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.MissingFieldsError.md): Exception raised when a date or datetime does not have all
the fields required by the function being called.
  - [Calendrical.ParseError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.ParseError.md): Returned (or raised) by `Calendrical.parse/2` when no sub-parser
could interpret the input as a date, time, datetime, or date
range.
  - [Calendrical.TimeParseError](https://calendrical.hexdocs.pm/Calendrical.TimeParseError.md): Returned (or raised) by `Calendrical.Time.parse/2` when an input
string cannot be interpreted as a time.
